title: Hearty Indian Cod Curry
description: A romantic Indian dish featuring cod in a bitter and creamy curry sauce, perfect for a special occasion, and friendly to sugar-free diets with no added sugars.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cod fillets to the marinade and coat evenly, then cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the canned tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Remove the cod from the marinade and add to the skillet, spooning some of the tomato mixture over the top of each fillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12 minutes, or until the cod is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
